fn improve_file(path, rounds) {
    h code = file_read(path)
    if code == null {
        log(str_concat("  SKIP: cannot read ", path))
        return null
    }

    log(str_concat("  File: ", path, " (", to_string(str_len(code)), " bytes)"))

    h cache_key = str_concat(path, "|", to_string(str_len(code)))
    h cached = cache.lru_get(IMPROVEMENT_CACHE, cache_key)
    if cached != null {
        log("  Cache hit — skipping")
        return cached
    }

    h initial_score = score_code(code)
    log(str_concat("  Initial score: ", to_string(initial_score["score"])))

    h current = code
    h history = []
    h r = 0
    while r < rounds {
        h proposal = propose_improvement(current, history)
        log(str_concat("  Round ", to_string(r + 1), ": ", proposal["issue"]))

        h improved = apply_improvement(current, proposal)
        h new_score = score_code(improved)

        arr_push(history, {
            round: r + 1,
            issue: proposal["issue"],
            score: new_score["score"],
            issues: 1
        })

        if new_score["score"] >= initial_score["score"] {
            current = improved
        }
        r += 1
    }

    h final_score = score_code(current)
    h improvement = final_score["score"] - initial_score["score"]
    log(str_concat("  Final score: ", to_string(final_score["score"]), " (delta: +", to_string(improvement), ")"))

    h result = {
        path: path,
        original: code,
        improved: current,
        initial_score: initial_score,
        final_score: final_score,
        improvement: improvement,
        history: history
    }

    cache.lru_put(IMPROVEMENT_CACHE, cache_key, result)

    if improvement > 0 {
        h backup = str_concat(path, ".bak")
        file_write(backup, code)
        log(str_concat("  Saved backup to ", backup))
    }

    return result
}

fn code_gen_loop(task_description, eval_prompt_template, generations) {
    h sys = str_concat(
        "You write clean, idiomatic OMC code. Rules:\n",
        "- h varname = value for bindings\n",
        "- fn name(args) { body } for functions\n",
        "- while condition { body } for loops\n",
        "- arr_push(arr, val), arr_len(arr), arr_slice(arr, start, end) for arrays\n",
        "- str_concat(a, b, ...) for string concat\n",
        "- Return ONLY the OMC code, no fences or explanation."
    )

    print(str_concat("Task: ", task_description))
    print("")

    h history = []
    h current_code = llm_call(
        str_concat("Write OMC code for: ", task_description),
        MODEL, sys
    )
    current_code = extract_code(current_code)

    h gen = 0
    while gen < generations {
        print(str_concat("--- Generation ", to_string(gen + 1), " ---"))

        h metrics = measure_code(current_code)
        print(str_concat(
            "  Lines: ", to_string(metrics["lines"]),
            " | Fns: ", to_string(metrics["functions"]),
            " | Loops: ", to_string(metrics["loops"])
        ))

        # Try to run it
        h run_result = safe_run(current_code, "")
        h run_status = "ok"
        if !run_result["ok"] { run_status = to_string(run_result["error"]) }
        print(str_concat("  Run status: ", run_status))

        arr_push(history, {
            gen: gen + 1,
            code: current_code,
            metrics: metrics,
            status: run_status
        })

        if gen + 1 >= generations { break }

        # Improve prompt
        h improve_prompt = str_replace(eval_prompt_template, "{{CODE}}", current_code)
        h improved = llm_call(improve_prompt, MODEL, sys)
        current_code = extract_code(improved)

        gen += 1
    }

    return {code: current_code, history: history, generations: generations}
}

fn run_debate(topic, rounds) {
    print(str_concat("=== Debate: ", topic, " ==="))
    print(str_concat("Rounds: ", to_string(rounds)))
    print("")

    h for_args = []

fn score_candidate(src, all_prev_srcs, prev_best_score) {
    # Skip candidates that aren't valid OMC — return 0 so they lose naturally
    if !omc_code_valid(src) { return 0.0 }

    h m   = omc_code_metrics(src)
    h cs  = omc_code_complexity(src)

    # Complexity: lower is better (max contribution 30)
    h complexity_contrib = 30.0 / (cs["complexity"] + 1)

    # Substrate alignment: fraction of attractor tokens (max 40)
    h sub  = omc_substrate_score(src)
    h sub_contrib = sub * 40.0

    # Token compression (higher = denser OMC vocabulary usage), max 20
    h comp_contrib = m["compression_ratio"] * 20.0

    # Diversity bonus: if this code is novel vs all prior candidates, +10
    h diversity = 10.0
    h i = 0
    while i < arr_len(all_prev_srcs) {
        h sim = omc_code_similarity(src, all_prev_srcs[i])
        if sim > 0.85 {
            diversity = 0.0
        }
        i += 1
    }

    h total = complexity_contrib + sub_contrib + comp_contrib + diversity
    return total
}

    h best_src   = seed_src
    h best_score = score_candidate(best_src, [], 0)
    h history    = []
    h prev_srcs  = [seed_src]

    print(str_concat("  [meta ", str_concat(to_string(meta_round),
          str_concat("] inner loop — seed score: ", to_string(best_score)))))

    h r = 0
    while r < inner_rounds {
        print(str_concat("    inner round ", str_concat(to_string(r + 1),
              str_concat("/", to_string(inner_rounds)))))

        # Generate N candidates
        h candidates = generate_candidates(
            spec, best_src, best_score,
            meta_round * inner_rounds + r,
            meta_hint, CANDIDATES_PER_ROUND
        )

        # Score each candidate; keep best
        h c = 0
        while c < arr_len(candidates) {
            h cand = candidates[c]
            h cscore = score_candidate(cand, prev_srcs, best_score)
            print(str_concat("      candidate ", str_concat(to_string(c + 1),
                  str_concat(": score=", str_concat(to_string(cscore),
                  format_metrics(cand))))))
            if cscore > best_score {
                best_score = cscore
                best_src   = cand
                print("      ↑ new best!")

            arr_push(prev_srcs, cand)
            c += 1
        }

        arr_push(history, {
            "round":   meta_round * inner_rounds + r + 1,
            "score":   best_score,
            "metrics": format_metrics(best_src)
        })

        r += 1
    }

    return {
        "best_src":   best_src,
        "best_score": best_score,
        "history":    history
    }
}

    # Initial meta-hint (Level 2 seed)
    h meta_hint = str_concat(
        "Improve the OMC code by:\n",
        "  1. Using dict-based memoization with dict_get/dict_set\n",
        "  2. Minimising branches (target complexity <= 2)\n",
        "  3. Preferring arr_get over index syntax\n",
        "  4. Keeping the function short (< 10 statements)\n"
    )

    h best_src   = seed_src
    h best_score = score_candidate(seed_src, [], 0)
    h all_history = []

    h m = 0
    while m < outer_rounds {
        print(str_concat("=== Meta-round ", str_concat(to_string(m + 1),
              str_concat("/", to_string(outer_rounds), " =================="))))

        # Level 1: inner improvement loop
        h result = inner_loop(spec, best_src, meta_hint, inner_rounds, m)
        best_src   = result["best_src"]
        best_score = result["best_score"]

        h inner_hist = result["history"]
        h hi = 0
        while hi < arr_len(inner_hist) {
            arr_push(all_history, inner_hist[hi])
            hi += 1
        }

        print(str_concat("  [meta ", str_concat(to_string(m + 1),
              str_concat("] best score so far: ", to_string(best_score)))))
        print(str_concat("  best code:\n", best_src))
        print("")

        # Level 2: meta-improve the improver guidance
        if m < outer_rounds - 1 {
            print("  [Level 2] Meta-improving the improver prompt...")
            meta_hint = meta_improve_hint(meta_hint, all_history, best_src, spec)
            print(str_concat("  new meta-hint:\n  ", meta_hint))
            print("")
        }

        m += 1
    }

    # Final report
    print("=== Final Report ===")
    print(str_concat("Total rounds: ", to_string(arr_len(all_history))))
    print("")
    print("Score history:")
    h hi2 = 0
    while hi2 < arr_len(all_history) {
        h entry = all_history[hi2]
        print(str_concat("  Round ", str_concat(to_string(entry["round"]),
              str_concat(": ", str_concat(to_string(entry["score"]),
              str_concat("  ", entry["metrics"]))))))
        hi2 += 1
    }
    print("")
    print("Best implementation:")
    print(best_src)
    print("")

    # Verify improvement
    h seed_score = score_candidate(seed_src, [], 0)
    h improved   = best_score > seed_score
    print(str_concat("Seed score:  ", to_string(seed_score)))
    print(str_concat("Final score: ", to_string(best_score)))
    print(str_concat("Improved:    ", if improved { "YES ✓" } else { "NO ✗" }))

    return {
        "improved":    improved,
        "seed_score":  seed_score,
        "final_score": best_score,
        "best_src":    best_src,
        "history":     all_history
    }
}

fn meta_improve(target_code, target_goal, meta_rounds) {
    h mr = meta_rounds
    if mr == null { mr = 2 }

    # Generate a simple improver function
    h improver_goal = "An OMC function improve_fn(code, goal) that calls llm_call to improve code"
    h improver_template = str_concat(
        "fn improve_fn(code, goal) {\n",
        "    h prompt = str_concat(\"Improve this OMC code for \", goal, \":\\n\", code)\n",
        "    h improved = llm_call(prompt, null, \"Write only OMC code, no explanation.\")\n",
        "    return improved\n",
        "}"
    )

    print("  Meta: improving the improver...")
    h improver_result = improve_to_convergence(improver_template, improver_goal, mr)
    h best_improver = improver_result["code"]

    print("  Meta: running improved improver on target...")
    h improvement_code = str_concat(
        best_improver, "\n\n",
        "improve_fn(", json_stringify(target_code), ", ", json_stringify(target_goal), ")"
    )
    h meta_result = run_code(improvement_code)
    h final_code = target_code
    if meta_result["ok"] and type_of(meta_result["value"]) == "string" {
        final_code = strip_fences(meta_result["value"])
    }

    return {
        code: final_code,
        improver: best_improver,
        meta_rounds: mr
    }
